The recorded 36.0 percent is the recorder's own figure: scripts/ci/adequacy_receipt.py starts coverage after the handler module is already imported, so 14 of its import, class and def lines run outside the window and, with the two property bodies, 16 of the 23 statements of handler_registry_api_get_node.py are counted as missed (2 branches, 0 partial, 36 percent).
